senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (पोषति) 4th cl. (पुष्यति) and 9th cl. (पुष्णाति)
To cherish or nurture, to rear, to bring up.
(इर) पुषिर r. 4th cl. (पुष्यति)
To share or divide.
r. 10th. cl. (पोषयति)
To put on, to wear.
With परि or सम्,
to cherish much, or bring up with care.

f. (-षा)
1 Cherishing.
2 A plant: see लाङ्गलिकी.
E.
पुष to cherish, aff. क and टाप्.

r. 1st cl. (पूषति)
1 To increase or grow: see पुष.
2 To nourish.

m. (-षः)
The mulberry, (Morus Indica.)
E.
पूष to grow, क aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Nourished, nurtured.
E.
पुष to nourish, aff. क्त; also without the augment पुष्ट.

n. (-रं)
1 The sky, heaven, atmosphere.
2 Water.
3 A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum or Nymphæa nelumbo.)
4 The tip of an elephant's trunk.
5 The head of a drum, or place where any musical instrument is struck.
6 A drug, (Costus speciosus.)
7 The name of a celebrated place of pilgrimage, now called Pokur, in the province of Ajmere, about four miles from the city of Ajmere, consisting of a small town on the bank of a lake, whence its name.
8 The blade of a sword.
9 The sheath of a sword.
10 One of the seven great Dvīpas or divisions of the universe.
11 An arrow.
12 The art or science of dancing.
13 War, battle.
14 Intoxication.
15 A cage.
16 A part.
17 Union.
m. (-रः)
1 A pond or lake.
2 A disease.
3 The Indian crane.
4 A sort of snake.
5 The name of a king, the brother of NALA.
6 The son of VARUṆA.
7 The name of a mountain, that in Puṣkara Dvīpa.
8 A drum.
9 One of the principal clouds, that which occasions dearth.
10 An inauspicious astrological combination of a lucky lunation with an unlucky day, and three-fourths of a lunar mansion.
E.
पुष to nourish, Uṇādi aff. करन्.

m. (-कः)
The root of the Costus speciosus.
E.
पुष्कर as above, and मूलक root.

f. (-फा)
The root of the lotus.

n. du. (-जौ)
The two sons of AŚVINĪ, and physicians of Svarga or paradise.
E.
पुष्कर a lotus, and स्रज् a necklace or chaplet; wearing such.

m. (-ह्वः)
The Indian crane.
E.
पुष्कर a lotus, and आह्वा an appellation; whence also any name of the lotus is applicable to the bird.

m. (-री)
An elephant.
f. (-णी)
1 A square or large pond.
2 A piece of water, a lake.
3 A pool, where the lotus does or may grow.
4 A female elephant.
E.
पुष्कर as above, इनि possessive aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Excellent, eminent, chief, best.
2 Much, many.
3 Full, filled, complete.
4 Near, approached.
5 Good, salutary.
6 Possessed of all good things.
n. (-लं)
The mountain Meru.
m. (-लः)
1 The holy place Puṣkara.
2 The son of VARUṆA.
3 A measure of eight Kuñcis or sixty-four handfuls; in some places it means four times a double handful.
4 Alms to the extent of four mouthfuls of food.
E.
पुष to nourish, and कलन् Uṇādi aff.; otherwise पुष्कर as above, and ल interchanged with र.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Nourished, cherished.
2 Burnt.
E.
पुष to cherish, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Fat, fattened.
E.
पुष्ट, and अङ्ग body.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 Cherishing, nourishing.
2 Increase, advance, thriving, prosperity.
3 One of the Mātṛkās or divine mothers, nourishment personified.
E.
पुष to nourish, aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-का)
An oyster.
E.
पुष्ट, and कन् added, fem. form.

m. (-न्तः)
GAṆEŚA.
E.
पुष्टि prosperity, कान्त friend.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Nourishing, cherishing.
f. (-दा)
1 Increase, thriving.
2 A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.)
E.
पुष्टि, and द what gives.

r. 4th. cl. (पुष्पति)
To flower, to blossom.

n. (-ष्पं)
1 A flower in general.
2 The menses.
3 Expansion, expanding.
4 The vehicle or car of KUVERA.
5 A disease of the eyes, specks on the eye, albugo.
f. (-ष्पा)
The capital of KARṆA, or Bhāgalpur.
E.
पुष्प to flower, &c. अच् aff.

n. (-कं)
1 Calx of brass.
2 The chariot of KUVERA.
3 A disease of the eyes, albugo, specks on the eye.
4 A bracelet of diamonds or jewels.
5 A cup or vessel of iron.
6 A small earthen fire-place or furnace.
7 A sort of collyrium.
8 Green vitriol.
E.
कन् added to the last.

n. (-कं)
Avanti or Oujein, or the grove in its vicinity considered as sacred to MAHĀDEVA.
E.
पुष्प a flower, and करण्डक a basket.

f. (-नी)
Oujein: see the last.

n. (-शं)
The green sulphate of iron.
E.
पुष्प a flower, and कासीश green vitriol.

m. (-टः)
1 A large black bee.
2 Any insect affecting flowers.
E.
पुष्प a flower, and कीट an insect.

m. (-नः)
The Hindu Cupid.
E.
पुष्प a flower, and केतन a symbol.

m. (-तुः)
1 Calx of brass.
2 The god of love.
E.
पुष्प flower, and केतु mark or sign.

f. (-का)
Contrary purpose or effort of a man and woman.

m. (-रिः)
A fabulous mountain, the favourite resort of VARUṆA.
E.
पुष्प a flower, and गिरि a mountain, the hill of flowers.

m. (-कः)
A bambu.
E.
पुष्प flower, and घातक destroyer; the stem decaying after the plant flowers.

n. (-यं)
1 A quantity of flowers.
2 Gathering flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and चय gathering.

m. (-पः)
KĀMADEVA, the Hindu Cupid.
E.
पुष्प a flower, and चाप a bow; who arms his bow with flowers.

m. (-रः)
1 A plant, (Artemisia.)
2 A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)
E.
पुष्प a flower, and चामर a Chowri, having a large bushy flower.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Who or what gives flowers.
m. (-दः)
A tree.
E.
पुष्प a flower, and द what gives.

m. (-न्तः)
1 The elephant of the north-west quarter.
2 A chief of the Gandharbas or Vidyādharas, attendant upon ŚIVA.
3 One of the Jinas or Jaina teachers.
4 A Nāga or serpent of the infernal regions.
m. dual. (-न्तौ)
The sun and moon.
E.
पुष्प flower, and दन्त a tooth.

m. (-कः)
A chief of the Gandharbas.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-वः)
1 The exudation or saccharine matter of flowers.
2 An infusion of flowers, as rose water, &c.
E.
पुष्प, and द्रव oozing, distilling.

m. (-घः)
The offspring of an outcaste Brahman.

m. (-न्वा)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
पुष्प, and धनु a bow, अनङ् aff. otherwise पुष्पधनुः see पुष्पचाष.

m. (-रः)
Throwing flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and नि before कॄ to throw, अच् aff.

m. (-क्षः)
A bee.
E.
पुष्प, and निक्ष who kisses.

m. (-सः)
Nectar of flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and निर्य्यास extract.

m. (-यः)
A bee.
E.
पुष्प a flower, धे to drink, aff. खश्.

m. (-थः)
The vulva.
E.
पुष्प the menses, and पथिन् a road अप् aff.

n. (-रं)
Pātaliputra or Palibothra.
E.
पुष्प flower, and पुर a city.

m. (-यः)
1 Gathering fruit or flowers, &c. any way except by the hand.
2 Stealing flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and प्र before चि to collect, aff. अच्.

m. (-यः)
Gathering flowers with the hand.
E.
पुष्प, and प्र before चि to collect, घञ् aff.

m. (-लः)
1 Elephant or wood apple.
2 A pumpkin gourd.
E.
पुष्प a flower, and फल fruit.

m. (-वः)
Nectar of flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and भव being.

f. (-का)
The blue lotus.

m. (-सः)
Spring.
E.
पुष्प flower, and मास a month or season.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Dyed red with vegetable colour, as safflower, &c.
m. (-क्तः)
A shrub, (Hibiscus phæniceus.)
E.
पुष्प flower, and रक्त coloured, red.

m. (-थः)
A car or carriage for travelling or pleasure, or any purpose except war.
E.
पुष्प a flower, and रथ a car.

m. (-सः)
The nectar or honey of flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and रस juice.

n. (-यं)
Honey, nectar.
E.
पुष्परस, and आह्वय name.

m. (-गः)
A topaz.
E.
पुष्प a flower, and राग colour.

m. (-णुः)
The dust or farina of flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and रेणु dust.

m. (-नः)
A plant, (Mesua ferrea.)
E.
पुष्प, and रोचन pleasing.

m. (-वः)
A flower-seller, a garland-maker.
f. (-वी)
A female flower-gatherer.
E.
पुष्प, and लाव who cuts.

m. (-क्षः)
A bee.
E.
पुष्प a flower, लिह to lick, स aff.

m. (-लिट्)
A large black bee.
E.
पुष्प, and लिह to lick, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having flowers, flowery.
m. always dual. (-न्तौ)
The sun and moon.
f. (-वती)
A woman during menstruation.
E.
पुष्प a flower, or expansion as at rising, &c. and मतुप् aff.

m. dual. (-न्तौ)
The sun and moon.
E.
पुष्प a flower, अव to prevent, भच् aff.

m. (-र्षः)
A rain of flowers, flowers cast from heaven upon a hero or demigod, or on any great occasion.
E.
पुष्प, and वर्ष raining; also पुष्पवर्षण, पुष्पवृष्टि, &c.

f. (-टी)
A flower garden.
E.
पुष्प, and वाटी a garden.

f. (-ष्टिः)
See पुष्पवर्ष.

f. (-टी)
Raining flowers, on any great occasion of rejoicing in earth and heaven.

m. (-रः)
KĀMADEVA, the god of love.
E.
पुष्प, and शर an arrow.

m. (-रः)
The nectar, or honey of flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and सार essence.

m. (-नः)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
पुष्प, and शरासन a quiver.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Not bearing flowers, flowerless.
E.
पुष्प, and शून्य void of.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Flowery.
E.
पुष्प, and शालिन् having.

f. (-श्रीः)
Abundance, or beauty of flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and श्री wealth.

m. (-यः)
Spring.
E.
पुष्प, and समय a season.

m. (-दः)
The nectar, or honey of flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and स्वेद sweat, or exudation.

f. (-सा)
A woman during menstruation.
E.
पुष्प, and हास who smiles.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Flowerless, not flowering.
f. (-ना)
1 The glomerous fig tree.
2 A woman whose menstruation has ceased, a barren woman.
E.
पुष्प a flower, &c. and हीन abandoned.

m. (-वः)
A flowerman, a maker of garlands.
E.
पुष्प, and आजीव livelihood.

m. (-वी)
A flowerman, a maker of garlands.
E.
पुष्प, आजीव livelihood, इनि aff.

n. (-नं)
The calx of brass.
E.
पुष्प a flower, and अञ्जन collyrium.

mf. (-लिः-ली)
Presenting a nosegay or flowers, held in both hands opened, and hollowed.
E.
पुष्प, and अञ्जलि the hands joined, and opened; also similar compounds, as कुसुमाञ्जलि, प्रसूनाञ्जलि, &c.

m. (-यः)
Gathering flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and अवचय collecting.

mf. (-यी-यिनी)
A flower-gatherer.
E.
पुष्प, and अवचायिन् who collects.

n. (-वं)
Honey.
E.
पुष्प, and आसव spirit.

m. (-स्त्रः)
KANDARPA, the Hindu Cupid.
E.
पुष्प, and अस्त्र a weapon; pointing his darts with flowers.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Who or what takes flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and आहर who or what takes.

f. (-का)
1 The tartar of the teeth.
2 The mucus of the glans penis, or urethra.
E.
पुष्प a flower, कन् aff. of comparison, fem. form.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Flowered, in flower.
f. (-ता)
A woman during menstruation.
E.
पुष्प, and इतच् aff.

f. (-ग्रा)
A form of metre, a mixed kind and a variety of the Aupacchandasika; the line consisting of four or six short syllables, a pyrrhic or a dactyl, two trochees and a spondee.

mfn. (-ष्पी-ष्पिणी-ष्पि)
Flowering, bearing flowers.
E.
पुष्प, and इनि aff.

m. (-षुः)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
पुष्प, and इषु an arrow.

mf. (-ष्यः-ष्या)
1 The eighth lunar asterism, comprising three stars, of which one is δ Cancer.
2 The month Paus, (Dec.-Jan.)
3 The Kali, or fourth age.
E.
पुष to nourish, aff. क्यप.

m. (-थः)
Any sort of car or carriage, except a war chariot.
E.
पुष्य the asterism, and रथ a car; also पुष्परथ.

m. (-कः)
1 The musk deer.
2 A pin, a bolt, a stake.
3 A naked mendicant. It is read in some places पुष्पलक.

r. 10th cl. (पुस्तयति)
1 To respect.
2 To disregard, to treat with disrespect.
3 To bind.
4 To smear.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Filled.
2 Covered.
n. (-स्तं)
1 Smearing, anointing, painting, plastering, &c.
2 Any thing made of metal, wood or clay, &c.
nf. (-स्तं-स्ती)
A book, a manuscript.
E.
पुस्त to bind, अच् aff.

nf. (-कं-की)
A book, a manuscript.
E.
कन् added to the last.

n. (-र्म्म)
Plaistering, painting, &c. see पुस्त.
E.
पुस्त as above, कर्म्मन् business.

m. (-सः)
The lungs; also पुप्फुस and फुप्फुस.

m. (-षा)
The sun.
E.
पूष to nourish, aff. कनिन्.

f. (-सा)
The capital of INDRA.
E.
पूष the sun, भास् light, aff. टाप्, splendid as the sun.

m. (-हृत्)
ŚIVA.
E.
पूष the sun, and सुहृत् a friend.
